name: codex-stop-inline-plan-uses-stored-plan-mode-when-marker-missed
description: Codex Stop hooks must allow inline proposed_plan responses when current Codex collaboration mode is plan, even when permission_mode is default.

transcript.content: Please investigate and produce a plan.

content.text:
<proposed_plan>
# Fix The Issue

## Summary
Use Codex collaboration-mode evidence to recognize Plan Mode even when permission_mode is default.

## Key Changes
- Keep explicit Codex collaboration markers authoritative.
- Do not treat permission_mode=default alone as proof that collaboration mode is Default.

## Tests
- Add unit coverage for the Stop hook false-block regression.

## Assumptions
- Codex collaboration mode is the source of truth for Plan Mode when present.
</proposed_plan>
